MHL Type Oil Gage

MHL Type Oil Gage

The MHL type oil gage has an impact-resistant structure at the mounting board set section, reducing the risk of breakage, and a white reflector plate behind the red-graduated oil level area lets you clearly check even the smallest changes in oil level.

Installation Method
Drill the screw hole for dimension E to match the hole pitch. Clamp the upper and lower boards firmly and evenly using flat bars for a secure installation. Install using normal force only — there is no need to tighten it any harder than that.

MHL形オイルゲージ
